details: The cryptocurrency market experienced a notable downturn, with Bitcoin sliding below $83,000. Over $1.19 billion in crypto positions were liquidated in the past 24 hours, with Ether seeing a heavy hit. US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded significant outflows, continuing a trend of institutional caution in October, despite Friday's slight recovery.
title: Bitcoin Dips, Crypto Liquidations Exceed $1 Billion, ETF Outflows Continue

details: The United States government transferred approximately 9,261 Bitcoin, including newly discovered seized funds, to Coinbase Prime. This move of a significant amount of BTC to an exchange could potentially influence market dynamics.
title: US Government Moves $770 Million in Seized Bitcoin

details: The XRP Ledger has implemented an emergency update to address and fix a long-standing vulnerability. This proactive measure aims to prevent potential financial losses and enhance the security of the network.
title: XRP Ledger Undergoes Emergency Security Update

details: A THORChain executive has alleged that Tether froze USDT vaults without prior notice. This incident raises concerns about transparency and centralized control within the stablecoin ecosystem and digital asset management.
title: THORChain Exec Claims Tether Froze USDT Vaults Without Notice

details: The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has given crypto firms three months to cease services for stablecoins that do not comply with the new MiCA regulations, with a deadline set for January 8.
title: EU Regulator Sets Stablecoin Compliance Deadline for Crypto Firms

details: Greece is preparing to levy a 10% capital gains tax on cryptocurrency transactions, which is a reduction from the 15% rate previously floated in June. This move signals increasing regulatory integration of digital assets.
title: Greece Proposes 10% Crypto Capital Gains Tax

details: New crypto rules in Thailand, effective October 16, will permit Thai asset managers to launch locally listed Bitcoin and Ether Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) on the local stock exchange. This development expands institutional access to major cryptocurrencies in the region.
title: Thailand to Allow Local Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs

details: Paxos Labs, in collaboration with partners, is exploring the expansion of tokenized commodities beyond traditional assets like gold. This initiative aims to broaden the use cases and institutional interest in the tokenization of real-world assets.
title: Paxos Labs Ventures into Tokenized Commodities
